description_en: Queries the global anti-virus configuration of the current Alibaba Cloud account, including the virus file upload switch and upload limits. If the current Alibaba Cloud account does not have its own configuration record, the default configurations are returned
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号的防病毒全局配置，包含病毒文件上传开关与上传限制。当前阿里云账号没有自己的配置记录时，返回系统默认配置
name: GetVirusScanGlobalConfig
